verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the models page. It points to zero data retention (ZDR) for enterprise customers, a Data Processing Agreement and a Privacy Policy, and says customer requests and responses are not used for training. That gives an enterprise-tier retention option, but nothing shows ordinary users controlling retention or deleting their own data. Missing for 10: self-serve retention settings for non-enterprise accounts, a documented deletion mechanism (API or console), details of the default retention period, and independent corroboration of how ZDR works.
